faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions? Here are immediate answers to common details about our tracks and placement.
faq.q1: What will I learn in this program?
faq.a1: You will learn practical skills, industry workflows, and complete hands-on projects designed to prepare you for career opportunities.
faq.q2: Is the program online or offline?
faq.a2: We offer flexible options: interactive live online classes and hybrid sessions depending on your program.
faq.q3: Do I need prior experience to enroll?
faq.a3: No prior experience is required. We welcome beginners and guide you step by step from the fundamentals to advanced techniques.
faq.q4: Will I receive a certificate after completing the program?
faq.a4: Yes. Upon completing the coursework and capstone project you will receive an official certificate of completion.
faq.q5: What if I miss a class?
faq.a5: All live sessions are recorded and available on the learning platform so you can catch up anytime.
faq.a6: Register through our website by choosing your program and completing the enrollment form.
faq.q7: Is there career support after graduation?
faq.a7: Yes: resume reviews, portfolio building, mock interviews, and hiring-partner connections.
